# Cut list - oven B (generated by `bom/build_bom.py`)

Grinder with a diamond disc for bricks (wet or with dust extraction, FFP3 mask). Saw or knife for boards and blankets.

## Bricks

- Floor: 7 columns x 4 rows laid flat (long side front-to-back). Columns 2, 4, 6 start and end with a half brick (115 mm): 3 bricks cut in half.
- Side walls: 16 bricks standing on end, no cuts.
- Skewbacks: 8 bricks, each cut lengthwise so one face lies at 51.1° from vertical (template `dxf/skewback_template.dxf`).
- Vault: 8 courses, bricks laid flat. Courses 2, 4, 6, 8 start and end with a half brick: 4 bricks cut in half. Joints: 2 mm at the intrados, opening to 16.3 mm at the back (fill with mortar).
- Door arch: 9 half bricks (115 mm long) on edge, radius 342 mm, rise 120 mm.

## Boards (CaSi 1200 x 600 x 25)

- Floor insulation: 5 layers, each 1036 x 1258 mm (2 boards + strip per layer; stagger the seams between layers).
- Thrust strips: 2 off, 1158 mm long, 150 mm (6 boards) wide x 64 mm high: boards cut into 64 mm strips and stood on edge.

## Steel (S235 angle L50x50x5)

- K-L: Skewback rail L - 1558 mm
- K-R: Skewback rail R - 1558 mm
- B-LF: Buckstay LF - 863 mm
- B-LB: Buckstay LB - 863 mm
- B-RF: Buckstay RF - 863 mm
- B-RB: Buckstay RB - 863 mm
- 4 foot cleats, 100 mm each; drill per base interface drawing.

## DXF files (`bom/dxf/`)

former_rib (3 off, 18 mm plywood), skewback_template, end_wall_back, end_wall_front (1:1 templates with course lines), end_panel_front, end_panel_back, shell_sheet (developed), door_front, hood_parts.
